note: Harvested from NSS Scenarios/Estimate at synthetic in-range inputs. NSS supplies no report table, covariance, model-error variance or site count, so this is a cross-check and starting point, not a verified equation library.
nss_sep_note: nss_sep is NSS's raw 'sep' field, stored verbatim. It is not confirmed to be the report's log10 standard error of prediction (MT NW region: 0.043 at 4% AEP vs 0.41 at 66.7%), so it is never mapped to sep_log.
